effects.name: Speed 0
effects.text: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.

effects.name: Attacks Affected
effects.text: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler.

effects.name: Movable
effects.text: The grappler can drag or carry you when it moves, but every foot of movement costs it 1 extra foot unless you are Tiny or two or more sizes smaller than it.
